description: Web app for field supervisors to upload agent CSVs, auto-generate geographic beats per GCU using KMeans clustering, assign beats to days of the week, and download per-day KML files for Google My Maps.

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js project with Tailwind and folder structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base Next.js 14 app with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS set up so that all other stories have a working foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 app created with App Router and TypeScript
Tailwind CSS configured and working
Folder structure: app/, components/, lib/, types/
iron-session installed and configured with PLANNER_PASSWORD env variable
papaparse and leaflet npm packages installed
ml-kmeans npm package installed for clustering
Root page redirects to /login if no valid session
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Login page with shared password
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to log in with a shared password so that only authorized users can access the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Login page at /login with single password input and submit button
Password checked against PLANNER_PASSWORD env variable via POST /api/auth/login
On success, iron-session cookie set and redirect to /dashboard
On failure, show 'Incorrect password' error message below the input
Logout button at /dashboard calls POST /api/auth/logout and redirects to /login
Middleware redirects unauthenticated requests from /dashboard to /login
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: CSV upload and parsing API route
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to upload an agent CSV so that the system can read the store data.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/upload accepts multipart/form-data with fields: file (CSV), agentName (string)
API parses CSV using papaparse and validates required columns: username, store_name, lat, long, gcu, last_delivered_date, 'bakit hindi umorder si customer?'
Excluded stores filtered out: 'Permanently Closed', 'Duplicate Account', 'Hindi mahanap yung tindahan'
Returns JSON: { agentName, totalStores, excludedCount, gcus: [{ gcu, storeCount }], stores: [...] }
Returns 400 with error message if file is missing, wrong format, or missing required columns
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Dashboard upload UI with agent name input
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want a dashboard where I can enter the agent name and upload their CSV so I can start the beat planning process.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard at /dashboard shows agent name text input (required) and CSV file drop zone
File drop zone accepts .csv files only, shows filename when selected
Upload button calls POST /api/upload with agentName and file
Loading state shown during upload
On success, show summary: total stores, excluded count, GCUs found with store counts
On error, show the error message returned by the API
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: KMeans clustering TypeScript implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a TypeScript function that clusters stores into geographic beats using KMeans with a minimum beat size so that beats can be generated from any GCU's stores.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/clustering.ts exports function: createBeats(stores: Store[], minSize: number): BeatResult[]
Uses ml-kmeans package for initial clustering with n_clusters = floor(stores.length / minSize)
After initial clustering, iteratively merges the smallest cluster into its nearest neighbor (by centroid distance) until all clusters have >= minSize stores
Returns array of BeatResult: { beatId: number, stores: Store[], color: string }
Beat colors assigned from fixed palette of 10 colors cycling if more beats
Function handles edge case where stores.length < minSize (returns one beat with all stores)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Beat generation API route
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want beats to be auto-generated per GCU after uploading so that I can see the geographic groupings.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/beats accepts JSON: { stores: Store[], minSize: number } (default minSize 75)
Groups stores by GCU, runs createBeats() per GCU
Beat IDs are unique across all GCUs (GCU A beats 0,1 + GCU B beats 2,3 etc.)
Returns JSON: { beats: [{ beatId, gcu, color, storeCount, stores: [{ username, store_name, lat, long, last_delivered_date, rejectionReason, daysDormant }] }] }
daysDormant calculated as today minus last_delivered_date in days; null if last_delivered_date is empty
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Beat map view with Leaflet
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to see all beats on an interactive map so that I can verify the geographic groupings look correct.
acceptanceCriteria: After beat generation, map renders below the upload summary using Leaflet.js
Each store shown as a circle marker colored by its beat color
Clicking a marker shows popup: store name, last order date, rejection reason
GCU filter dropdown allows showing all GCUs or one specific GCU
Beat legend shown below map: colored swatch + Beat N label + store count
Map auto-fits bounds to show all stores
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Day assignment UI per beat
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to assign each beat to a day of the week so that I can plan the agent's weekly schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: Below the map, a table lists all beats: Beat ID, GCU, store count, day dropdown
Day dropdown options: Unassigned, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday
Multiple beats can share the same day
Summary row at bottom shows how many beats are assigned per day
Unassigned beats are excluded from KML download
Day assignments stored in React state (not persisted)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: KML generation API route
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an API route that generates a valid KML file for a given day's beats so that supervisors can download it for Google My Maps.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/kml accepts JSON: { agentName: string, day: string, beats: BeatResult[] }
Returns KML file as download (Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=route-[agentName]-[day].kml)
KML structure: Document > Schema (ExtendedData fields) > Style per beat > Folder per beat > Placemark per store
ExtendedData columns per store: Beat, Last Order, Days Dormant, Rejection Reason
Pin icon uses http://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/micons/[color].png per beat
All text content XML-escaped (& → &, < → <, etc.)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Download KML by day UI
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to select a day and download the KML for that day so that I can share it with the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Download section appears once at least one beat is assigned to a day
Day selector shows only days that have at least one beat assigned
Download button calls POST /api/kml and triggers browser file download
Button shows loading state while generating
Downloaded filename format: route-[agentName]-[day].kml (e.g. route-JuanDelacruz-monday.kml)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
